review_method: Publicly accessible publisher abstracts, author/industry pages and article text; no independently commissioned metallurgical review. Primary source links retained; unsupported numeric rules removed.
evidence_policy: External sources support qualitative mechanisms and testwork design, not synthetic coefficients, costs or site approval.

sources.authors: S. C. Dominy; H. J. Glass
sources.title: Geometallurgical Sampling and Testwork for Gold Mineralisation: General Considerations and a Case Study
sources.basis: Representativity, QA/QC, coarse-gold sampling, drillcore and composite samples; §2.4, §4.7
sources.does_not_support: Fixed Au grade/recovery extrapolation for the synthetic ore C

sources.title: Modern gold deportments and its application to industry
sources.basis: Gold occurrence/liberation/host minerals and diagnostic gravity/cyanidation testing; abstract
sources.does_not_support: Numerical Au-in-sulfides threshold for compulsory POX

sources.title: A Laboratory Procedure To Determine The Amount Of Gravity Recoverable Gold
sources.basis: GRG test and sampling/repeatability issues; abstract
sources.does_not_support: Direct equation from coarse-Au percentage to operating-plant recovery

sources.title: Understanding the discrepancy between prediction and plant GRG recovery for improving the gold gravity performance
sources.basis: Lab GRG and actual gravity plant recovery can differ materially; abstract
sources.does_not_support: A universal conversion factor valid for any ore

sources.title: Improved recovery of a low-grade refractory gold ore using flotation–preoxidation–cyanidation methods
sources.basis: Experiments comparing flotation, oxidative pretreatment and cyanidation for one refractory ore; abstract
sources.does_not_support: Synthetic ore B is identical to the study ore or has the same optimum

sources.title: Effect of grain size on the bacterial oxidation of a refractory gold sulfide concentrate and its dissolution by cyanidation
sources.basis: BIOX experimental response depends on grain size, solids and residence time; 14-day tests; abstract
sources.does_not_support: A two-day BIOX test is a qualified comparison with POX

sources.title: Combined Bacterial and Pressure Oxidation for Processing High-Sulfur Refractory Gold Concentrate
sources.basis: BIOX industrial residence time commonly 4–6 days dependent on ore and conditions; source introduction
sources.does_not_support: Six days guarantees equal or complete oxidation

sources.authors: Canadian Institute of Mining, Metallurgy and Petroleum (CIM)
sources.title: Leading Practice Guidelines for Mineral Processing
sources.basis: Representativity, adequate testwork across deposit variability, professional review
sources.does_not_support: Synthetic cases are engineering-qualified solely by passing unit tests

sources.title: Heap leaching amenability — gold extraction
sources.basis: Gold heap leach: agglomeration, column, flow and carbon testwork, charge-size context
sources.does_not_support: 10.5 mm/h unconfined infiltration proves heap mechanical/hydraulic feasibility

sources.title: Properties governing the flow of solution through crushed ore for heap leaching
sources.access: publisher snippets, full body accessible in search
sources.basis: Crushed-ore hydraulics, particle size/fines and load-dependent bed properties; cited design criteria are context-specific
sources.does_not_support: Any universal Ksat/rate pass threshold without ore and heap dimensions

sources.authors: D. T. Kinard; A. A. Schweizer
sources.title: Engineering Properties of Agglomerated Ore in a Heap Leach Pile
sources.basis: In-place heap ore studied using permeability, compaction and strength testing; abstract
sources.does_not_support: Site suitability inferred from unloaded laboratory infiltration only

sources.title: A review of Preg-robbing and the impact of chloride ions in the pressure oxidation of double refractory ores
sources.basis: Total carbon content is a poor predictor of preg-robbing; direct gold-uptake test and speciation required
sources.does_not_support: A/C/D organic carbon 0.12% proves absence of preg-robbing
